scheme_name: Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
description:
The Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme was launched by the Government of Assam on 1st April 2021. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education. 

The primary objective is to make education accessible to economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme specifically targets students who have taken education loans from financial institutions. 

The government aims to provide a subsidy on the interest component of these loans. 

The subsidy is intended to ease the financial burden on students and their families. 

Under this scheme, the government provides a subsidy of up to 5 percent on the interest rate of education loans. 

The maximum amount of subsidy provided is capped at ₹50,000 per year. 

This subsidy is applicable for a maximum of five years for each student. 

The total subsidy amount can therefore reach up to ₹2,50,000 over the duration of the loan. 

The scheme is applicable for students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses. 

Eligible courses include those in engineering, medical, management, and other professional fields. 

Students must have secured admission to recognized institutions for higher education. 

The scheme is specifically designed for students from families with an annual income of less than ₹8 lakh. 

This income limit ensures that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of society. 

Students must be residents of Assam to qualify for this scheme. 

The application process for the Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme is straightforward. 

Students must first secure an education loan from a recognized bank or financial institution. 

After securing the loan, students need to fill out the application form for the subsidy. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the Assam government. 

Students must provide necessary documents along with the application form. 

Required documents include proof of income, loan sanction letter, and proof of admission. 

Students must also submit their Aadhaar card and bank account details. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes around 30 days. 

Upon successful verification, the subsidy amount will be credited directly to the student's bank account. 

The subsidy is disbursed annually based on the interest paid by the student. 

Students must submit proof of interest payment to avail of the subsidy. 

The Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme is implemented by the Department of Education, Government of Assam. 

For any queries or assistance, students can contact the Department of Education. 

The official contact number for the Department of Education is +91-361-223-0000. 

Students can also visit the official website for more information on the scheme. 

The scheme has been well-received since its launch. 

It has significantly reduced the financial burden on many families in Assam. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

This allocation is expected to benefit approximately 20,000 students annually. 

The scheme aims to enhance the literacy rate and educational attainment in Assam. 

It is part of the broader initiative by the Assam government to promote higher education. 

The scheme also encourages students to pursue professional courses. 

This is crucial for improving employment opportunities in the state. 

The Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme is a step towards achieving educational equity. 

It addresses the financial barriers that many students face in accessing higher education. 

The government has also conducted awareness programs to inform students about the scheme. 

These programs aim to reach out to students in remote areas of Assam. 

The subsidy is applicable for loans taken from both public and private banks. 

Students can avail of this scheme for loans taken for studies within India and abroad. 

However, the institutions must be recognized by the relevant authorities. 

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on the overall educational landscape in Assam. 

It aligns with the national goal of increasing gross enrollment ratios in higher education. 

The Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme is a significant initiative. 

It reflects the commitment of the Assam government towards education. 

The scheme is a vital resource for students aspiring for higher education. 

It provides much-needed financial support to those in need. 

The government encourages eligible students to apply for the scheme. 

This will ensure that they can pursue their educational goals without financial constraints. 

The Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme is a commendable effort. 

It aims to empower the youth of Assam through education. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the socio-economic development of the state.
